newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Bechtel to build 52-storey building in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Bechtel to build 52-storey building in Manila.

text.p: Bechtel International Inc, a unit of Bechtel Corp of the United States, will construct a 52-storey twin office building in Manila's Makati business district, the company selling office space in the towers said on Thursday.

Realtors Cuervo Far East Inc said the building, which will be located on a 8,000 square metre site sold by the Philippine National Bank earlier in the year, will have more than 240,000 square metres of office space when completed.
No other details were immediately available.
The property was bought for 3.68 billion pesos by a local business firm, RJ Ventures Realty and Development Corp.
